title: Though Google's SynthID tech for watermarking AI images is hard to break, there will always be ways to create AI-generated content without any labeling (Ryan Whitwam/Ars Technica)
summary: Ryan Whitwam / Ars Technica: Though Google's SynthID tech for watermarking AI images is hard to break, there will always be ways to create AI-generated content without any labeling — Deciding what's real on the Internet won't be easy in the future. — The scale of AI-generated media can be hard to grasp.
